json_ld.description:
Elevated dog beds naturally promote airflow beneath the sleeping surface, helping regulate your dog’s temperature while they rest. When it’s time for added warmth or cushioning, the Mt. EverRest™ Dog Cot Cover provides a perfect solution. This insulated cover acts as a skirt to enclose the space beneath the cot and block cold drafts. Great for all seasons, the reversible cover features a soft microsuede sleeping surface on one side and a lightweight, durable nylon ripstop on the other side. 
Forget the hassle of trying to keep blankets in place, this insulated cot cover is a seamless fit and easy to install or remove.
Pair with the Mt. EverRest™ Dog Cot (sold separately).
Dimensions: 30 in x 38 in x  8 in (76 cm x 96 cm x 20 cm)
json_ld.name: Mt. EverRest™ Insulated Dog Cot Cover
